label: TP
reason: User-controlled query string parameter flows directly to response.getWriter().print() without HTML escaping. URLDecoder.decode() does not mitigate XSS risks—it only decodes encoded characters. The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled (set to "0"), removing browser-level protections.

evidence.note: User input from getQueryString() flows through substring extraction, URL decoding, and directly to response.getWriter().print() without sanitization
X-XSS-Protection header disabled, confirming no client-side XSS prevention
